## Cosmic OS Review Checklist

- [ ] **Deterministic execution** — Does this change preserve deterministic execution via versioned tuning?
- [ ] **Budgets & guardrails** — Are time, cost, and bulk budgets enforced?
- [ ] **Explainability** — Is `Explain()` updated with rationale and expected impact?
- [ ] **Envelope schema** — Do new nodes emit the full uniform envelope?
- [ ] **Fail-open & rollback** — Are fail-open and rollback paths validated?
- [ ] **Privacy** — Is PII minimized/redacted in new logs or fields?
- [ ] **Preview-first** — Was the risky action previewed before applying?
